name: Glasswind Scarp
description: A sheer scarp of wind-polished rock, hot enough at noon to burn a bare hand. Old pick marks climb its face.

discovery.message: Wind has scoured a scarp down to bare, ore-dark rock. Someone mined it once.

face.text: The scarp is baked hard by the sun, and the wind has polished the ore veins until they shine. Hard going, but rich.

leave.text: You shoulder your pack and leave the seam behind.
